name: comrak-wasm
description: WebAssembly bindings for comrak — a fast CommonMark + GFM Markdown parser and renderer

scripts.build: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-name comrak --out-dir pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/comrak_wasm.wasm && mv pkg/comrak_bg.wasm pkg/comrak.wasm && wasm-opt -Oz pkg/comrak.wasm -o pkg/comrak.opt.wasm && mv pkg/comrak.opt.wasm pkg/comrak.wasm && mv pkg/comrak_bg.wasm.d.ts pkg/comrak.wasm.d.ts && perl -i -pe 's/comrak_bg\.wasm/comrak.wasm/g' pkg/comrak.js pkg/comrak.d.ts pkg/comrak.wasm.d.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run check:js && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:rust
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm test && pnpm run build:playground
